fields.hero_prompt: Build an image survey that shows my 300 customers three new candle labels and saves each pick in a database.

faq_plan.q: How do I create an image survey?

plan.angle: The top 10 is stock photo galleries plus survey-tool feature pages that show a picture question and stop there. This page shows four image surveys built from a prompt, each ending in a decision someone made from the picks: a packaging test, a ranked logo vote, a pick-two menu vote and a staff photo quiz with a pass mark. The how-to covers photographing options alike, labels, shuffled order and reading picks against the number asked.
tab_stories: Ashvale Tea Co. shows 412 customers three tin designs in shuffled order, tin B takes 198 picks against 121 for A and 93 for C, and tin B goes to the printer.
Duskwater Rowing Club asks 210 members to drag four logo drafts into order, 136 rank them, draft C is ranked first by 61, and the board adopts it.
Hallowfen Bakery shows 288 customers six cake photos and lets each pick two, the cranberry tart (141) and pistachio roll (118) take the top two spots, and both go on the holiday menu.

Ketterly Hardware gives 18 new hires a 12-photo image quiz on fasteners with a pass mark of 10, 14 pass, the store manager gets the results in Slack, and the 4 who scored under 10 retake it after a shift in the fastener aisle.
